steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Ferdinand... Director of Energy.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Well, that's kinda a surprise, but you know what really bothers me?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Just what the hell was Saria doing there?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I wanted to ask you about that myself. Why was Saria there, Director Muelsyse?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: What do you mean by that?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Saria was your right-hand man in this incident, wasn't she? Out more accurately, she was your former right-hand man.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Oh? What makes you think that?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Ever since we started our conversation, I've been wondering where you come in in this string of events.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You said you have nothing to do with HydeBro and Energy, and I believe you, but since you went out of your way to find me, you're perhaps a little too passionate for someone who's supposedly just an observer who knows about this incident.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: So my preliminary judgment is that you are most likely my 'competitor' as far as this incident goes.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You want Anthony as well.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: And the thing that puzzles me the most is what Saria was doing there.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: She's completely cut ties with Rhine Lab. She's a Rhodes Island operator right now.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The way I see it, she had no reason to get involved.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Well, I could probably say she's your trump card too.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I really didn't know she was there when it all happened.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I still remember what you said in the beginning—

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: The only parts I understand are the beginning—

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: —HydeBro initiated this assassination plot they'd been brewing forever against Anthony Simon—the last of the Simons—who was locked up in Mansfield State Prison.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: And then the very end—

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: —where Anthony led a group that successfully escaped Mansfield, and then met up with you two, and made it out of Columbia.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: As for everything in between... well, I had a chance to find out, but that's slipped away by now. Very sad about that.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: As my 'competitor', you'd know more than just that. You likely had an accomplice, who should've told you everything that happened there.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But that's all you know, and from all indications, it seems you really don't know that much about how everything unfolded there.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: And considering how Saria showed up out of nowhere...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The only conclusion I can draw is—

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: She was working with you, but she turned her back on your agreement.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But if that was really the case, then your appearance would also be unexpected. So why would she hand Anthony over to you?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: It's true that all of you are working with Rhodes Island, but if everything's exactly as you said, you two wouldn't exactly be on the same side, no?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: No, and I really didn't understand why until just now either. Kafka certainly didn't stand a chance against her, so in theory she should've been the true victor of this whole incident.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: And well... We didn't really know each other either, so she really didn't have much of a reason to hand Anthony over to me.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But I think I know the reason now.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Aha, I get it. She was trying to trick me.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Exactly.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: This is just my assumption.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: To her, having control over... Actually, no, I don't really want to call it that...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Let's call it a rescue. By rescuing Anthony, she became the ultimate victor.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: She thinks the best place for Anthony to be isn't where you are. That would only help grow your influence, so she probably chose to take matters into her own hands.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I don't know what it is that she's doing, and I don't want to know, but she definitely knows that HydeBro won't let this slide, nor will you, now that she has betrayed you.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: So that's why she didn't show up until the very end. She wanted to hide the fact she was ever involved in this whole incident.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I don't really think she's scared of me or HydeBro, but okay. Probably better to just let sleeping dogs lie. I would do that too if I were her.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Besides, she probably still has something else to take care of here in Columbia... Oh, whatever. It probably doesn't have anything to do with this.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: She... Whatever. Anyway, the fact we were there was probably just as much of a surprise to her. She probably got the gist of our situation from Kafka and arrived at that decision.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: ...Beautiful reasoning, Ms. Silence.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You're exactly right. I was the one who told Saria about this.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: And my guess is Jesselton was put in jail after that; they probably figured out right afterwards that he wasn't a real prison guard. That's why I don't have much information about him.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I really got thrown for a loop by Saria this time, though. I mean, I knew she wasn't going to hand him over to me right from the start, but still...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Then why did you ask her to help?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Well, obviously—

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I didn't have a choice.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: There wasn't anyone in the company trustworthy and capable enough.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: If there was anyone else I could've turned to, I wouldn't have bothered asking her.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I may be Ecological's director, but I'm not actually all that powerful.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Look at how miserable I am. She stole the guy from me, and now I've got to rack my brains to see how I can get him back. You couldn't find a more miserable section director if you tried.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: So it's exactly as I thought. You brought me here because you want me to hand Anthony over to you.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: If I said yes, would you do it?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Anthony has already left. He's on his way to Rhodes Island. I could tell you yes, but that won't change anything.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Relax. That was my plan in the beginning, but I've had a little change of heart.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: First of all, if my hunch is correct, Rhodes Island has nothing to do with this whole affair. Your entourage is only here because they're your bodyguards on your little trip here to procure equipment, right?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: That's right. I did that not as a member of Rhodes Island, but as an individual. I... I lied to them.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Well, you're not a good liar, Ms. Silence.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Anyway, I get the gist of it now.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Your goal is probably to make Anthony a Rhodes Island operator or, at the very least, put him under the company's protection. That's the best course of action in your opinion.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: And well, setting aside the question of whether Anthony would willingly subject himself to Saria's grumpiness, Saria probably wanted to keep Anthony on her leash.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But even if Anthony's okay with it, Saria probably thinks he's nothing but trouble.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: That's why she chose to have him join you guys at Rhodes Island. It's a pretty good choice.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Actually, she probably thinks that it's all good enough for her as long as Anthony makes it out of the prison alive and things don't go either my way or Ferdinand's.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: As for what Anthony wants to do and what he can do once out of prison, that doesn't matter to her one bit.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Is that so?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: That's right. It's hard for me to imagine Saria caring about others. Actually, it felt pretty strange to me when she agreed to help me out.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: But why is she okay with him joining Rhodes Island? Things could get out of hand with him at Rhodes Island too.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Probably because it keeps this whole prison affair relatively low key. If someone really looked into this mess, it would put HydeBro in the limelight, and those guys would do whatever it takes to cover all this up.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: And even though Rhodes Island and Rhine Lab work together, as long as all this is kept under wraps, there's going to be a lot of room to turn things around.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: In other words, if Anthony becomes a Rhodes Island operator, he'll actually be pretty safe for the time being.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I don't really know much about Saria's work relationship with Rhodes Island, but I know a thing or two about this company.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I think if I were Rhodes Island's leader, I wouldn't mind taking in Anthony at all.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Eh, I'm so lost...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Well, to put it simply, Saria snatched away something I was hoping she would give me.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But she didn't keep it for herself. She pawned it to a pretty well-guarded shop.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Oh, that's much easier to understand. But... what about it?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: So you want me, an employee of the pawn shop, to talk the owner into selling the item in question to you?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Bingo~

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: If Saria decided to keep Anthony around, I guess there wasn't anything I could've done about it for the time being.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But since she chose to turn him over to Rhodes Island, there's still room for me to intervene.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Don't worry, I'm not asking you to do this all by yourself.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: If Saria, the former Defense Director, was able to form a partnership with Rhodes Island, then I'm sure they'll be willing to work with me, the Ecological Director, too.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I'm hoping you'll act as an intermediary between me and Rhodes Island. In return, I will give you an opportunity to come back to Rhine Lab.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: It might even be the perfect opportunity for you to salvage the whole 'Diαbolic Crisis' situation.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Eh, this all sounds like you guys are about to do something bad.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Don't get the wrong idea, Ms. Mayer. This is just business.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Most things in the world aren't full of tender loving care.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Just like how Rhodes Island only took in Saria because they saw value in her.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: And just like how Saria handed Anthony to you guys because she thought you two would be able to escort him back to Rhodes Island safely.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: As for me, I believe that even if Rhodes Island does end up taking Anthony in, they aren't going to offer him a helping hand just because he tells them about his past.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: We can slap a fancy label on everything to make them seem less ugly on the outside, but that doesn't actually make them any more beautiful.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Let me give you an example. I could tell you I have very little power within the company, and then sing the praises of Control and tell you how amazing of a leader she is to make you think helping me is actually the right call.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: If I had done that, you definitely wouldn't have reacted the same way as you just did.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: And, you know, I'm actually really good at doing that.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But I didn't do that out of the respect I have for Ms. Silence after our conversation today.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Out of respect, if you give me this lead, Anthony, I am willing to give you something that's worth just as much, if not more. What do you say, Ms. Silence?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Silence, what should we do?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I refuse.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Oh? How come? I think what I'm offering is beyond attractive.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Director Muelsyse, from the beginning till the very end of our conversation, you haven't ever asked me what I wanted to do with Anthony.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Did you subconsciously arrive at the conclusion that, just like you and Saria, I want Anthony, this 'lead,' as well?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Am I wrong?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: He'll be one of the ways via which I'll keep Energy in check. As for Saria, I don't really know what's on her mind, but I'm sure she has her uses for him as well.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: As for you.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You're a Rhine Lab researcher who had to leave the place because of an experiment gone wrong. You want to use him to wrangle something from Rhine Lab.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Am I wrong?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I don't plan on using your so-called 'lead,' Director Muelsyse.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: If Saria didn't show up, and Anthony was rescued some other way and then met up with Mayer and me, I would still have told him to join Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm not doing this because I want to keep a leash on him, your 'lead,' through Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Throughout our entire conversation, you used the word 'lead' to describe him over and over. I don't really like calling him that.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Anthony isn't a 'lead' to me. He's a person; he's alive.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: His entire family was put behind bars in just one night, and he himself was locked up in that place for six years!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: If there was a better place for him to be, I naturally would've told him and helped him get there.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm not trying to keep him around to use as a bargaining chip in the future.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: That's what I think is the right thing to do.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Looks like we aren't going to come to an understanding.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: ...I'm afraid not.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: If you don't need anything else from us, we'll take our leave now.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Eh, you don't really think I'll just let you walk out of here after I told you all that, right? Researcher Silence?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I don't.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: That's why I made an arrangement with food on hand.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Anthony!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Right here.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You... I thought you'd already left Columbia!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The one who left was a decoy. The real Anthony has been staying with us at the hotel, and I asked him to come earlier just in case.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: It was our Rhodes Island escort's idea. I didn't expect to see this arrangement come in handy here, though.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You want Anthony, don't you?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: This is your only chance to get your hands on him, Director Muelsyse.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Care for a drink, Mr. Anthony?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: If the circumstances were different, I would gladly share a drink with you, Ms. Muelsyse.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: That's a shame, then. Let's get down to business.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Well, Mr. Anthony, would you be willing to come with me?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Only if you're able to defeat me, ma'am.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I eavesdropped on your conversation, and I must say that I don't really dislike the way you think.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I, too, think that there are certain things that aren't quite as colorful as they may seem.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: But, after all that I've been through, I also think that there are things out there that are truly beautiful.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Well, looks like I'm being treated as the villain here.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: No, I told you before, Director Muelsyse.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I don't think you're a villain.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: From where you stand, what you've done couldn't be more correct, and I also think you've extended to me plenty of goodwill gestures.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: It's just, I'm sorry to say this, I can't bring myself to agree with the way you think. That's all.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: It kinda feels like I made myself a new enemy without knowing.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You mentioned keeping Energy in check. Did something happen inside Rhine Lab?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: If you aren't going to make this deal with me, then I really can't tell you about any of that.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Of course, if you don't plan on calling it quits here, I'm sure you'll find out one day.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Anyway, I'm throwing in the towel.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I'm not really that confident I fight a buff dude like Anthony with just a clone.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: A clone?!

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: That's right, this is just a clone. Looks real, doesn't it?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Let me leave you with an advice, Researcher Silence.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You may think that helping Anthony is the right thing to do.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But that couldn't be further from the truth.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: It's laughable to think the Simon Co. was merely a victim in their fight with HydeBro.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Both of them fought that battle because they were bent on bringing the other side down. It's just Old Smith wasn't playing the game as well as his opponent was.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: In other words, if Smith had managed to make his move before HydeBro did, it would be the Hydes that's hunkering down in Bunkerhill right now instead of his family.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: From that point of view, is Anthony really just a victim?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: What do you think, Anthony?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I can't deny that.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But there are no 'ifs' in this world. I know that.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Researcher Silence, I am telling you all this because I want you to understand this—

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: If you want to do the right thing, you need to first be able to tell what actually is the right thing. Beyond that, you also need to understand that doing the right thing doesn't necessarily mean you don't have to pay the price.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Thanks for the advice.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Well, see ya.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Whoa, she turned into a puddle!

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Oh, right. I'm really throwing in the towel with Anthony. Rest assured, you won't find me doing anything uncalled for.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You can talk through the puddle too...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I might even help you guys cover this up. Better thank me.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: As long as I'm not your villain, let's have another chat the next time we get the chance.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Mr. Anthony, I hope you'll have a wonderful time at Rhodes Island~

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: ...I appreciate that, Miss.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Well then, Ms. Silence. It's actually time to set out now, isn't it?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Mayer, could you help me up?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Hmm? What's wrong?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: My legs are a little sore...

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Oh, okay.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Hff... phew...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I should've expected as much from a section director. I was so nervous just now, I almost couldn't say anything.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: The way I see it, you did really well, Ms. Silence.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Yeah, I think so too. You were really cool.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I'm curious. What kind of a place is Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: It's a long way to Rhodes Island from here. I'll explain everything you want to know along the way.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I see. Very well, then. I'm looking forward to this journey already.
